summary: Frye Mountain tower re-erected in 1931 and staffed to 1991; sources give 2002 or 2005 for its move to Swan Island WMA, where it is listed as standing; registered 2008.

access.note: Swan Island WMA is a public state area with shelters and a fishing pond; no climbing rules for the old tower were found

events.note: Dismantled tower re-erected on Frye Mountain in Waldo County, per a 1931 state forestry report quoted on Eastern U.S. Lookouts
Register says disassembled in 2002 and moved to Swan Island; Wikipedia gives the same year
Eastern U.S. Lookouts says the tower was removed around 2002, then moved and reassembled on Swan Island in 2005; this conflicts with the 2002 date

notes_for_editor: Move year conflicts (2002 vs 2005). A travel article (2003) and a Forest Fire Lookout Association Maine Facebook post (2005) appeared only in search results and were not read, so they are not cited. The state's wildlife viewing tower is probably this tower, but the state page does not say so. Read budget exceeded by about two pages.
